source_material_or_draft: We use ETT, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic datasets. We compare with Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, and DLinear. We use MSE and MAE as metrics, and the lookback window is 96.
structural_constraints: S1 [数据集选型逻辑 Dataset Selection Rationale]：To evaluate performance across diverse non-stationary regimes, we conduct experiments on [N] benchmarks spanning [Domain 1], [Domain 2], and [Domain 3].

S2 [极端/困难特性突出 Challenging Dataset Properties]：Notably, [Dataset A] exhibits [Hard Property 1, e.g., strong covariate shift], whereas [Dataset B] tests scalability across [Hard Property 2, e.g., 862 correlated channels].
S3 [基线流派全覆盖 Baseline Family Coverage]：We compare our method against [K] competitive baselines grouped into three families: [Family 1], [Family 2], and [Family 3].
S4 [公平评测协议 Fair Evaluation Protocol]：All models are evaluated under identical lookback windows ($L=96$), prediction horizons ($H \in \{96, 192, 336, 720\}$), and hyperparameter search budgets.

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Technical_Benchmark_Report 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT17 (AI 系统评测报告全文：长序列预测与生成模型在历史实测与未来算力扩展下的精度-延迟帕累托报告)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP17 -> BP18 -> BP22`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: We use ETT, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic datasets. We compare with Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, and DLinear. We use MSE and MAE as metrics, and the lookback window is 96.
structural_constraints: S1 [数据集选型逻辑 Dataset Selection Rationale]：To evaluate performance across diverse non-stationary regimes, we conduct experiments on [N] benchmarks spanning [Domain 1], [Domain 2], and [Domain 3].

S2 [极端/困难特性突出 Challenging Dataset Properties]：Notably, [Dataset A] exhibits [Hard Property 1, e.g., strong covariate shift], whereas [Dataset B] tests scalability across [Hard Property 2, e.g., 862 correlated channels].
S3 [基线流派全覆盖 Baseline Family Coverage]：We compare our method against [K] competitive baselines grouped into three families: [Family 1], [Family 2], and [Family 3].
S4 [公平评测协议 Fair Evaluation Protocol]：All models are evaluated under identical lookback windows ($L=96$), prediction horizons ($H \in \{96, 192, 336, 720\}$), and hyperparameter search budgets.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 学术演讲图表/架构讲解逐字稿（Visual Walkthrough）
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在演讲到架构图或核心实验曲线（Slide 4 / Slide 7）时，用最自然的口语引导听众的眼睛先看哪、再看哪，瞬间读懂图表背后的胜出逻辑。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP42` 与全文样板 `FT17` 的后半部分（`BP28 -> BP30`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Our contributions are: 1. A new model is proposed. 2. Solving the non-stationary problem. 3. Good results on datasets.
structural_constraints: S1 [视觉坐标锁定 Spatial Pointer]：Let's look at the comparison in the right panel of Slide 5, where the horizontal axis tracks prediction horizon and the vertical axis shows MSE.
S2 [引导观察反方崩溃曲线 Guide to Baseline Curve]：Notice the dashed orange curve representing the standard Transformer baseline: past 336 steps, error shoots up almost vertically.
S3 [引导观察我方稳定曲线 Guide to Our Curve]：Now compare that with our solid blue curve at the bottom, which stays flat even out to 720 steps.
S4 [一句话点破视觉差距原因 One-Sentence Takeaway]：That gap comes directly from our neural-ODE scale tracker preventing long-range drift.
